'''''Opuntia leucotricha''''' is a species of [[cactus]] with the common names: '''arborescent pricklypear''', '''Aaron's beard cactus''', and '''semaphore cactus'''; and (in [[Spanish (language)|Spanish]]) ''duraznillo blanco'' and ''nopal blanco''.<ref name="grin">{{GRIN | accessdate = 16 January 2018}}</ref>

==Description==
''Opuntia leucotricha'' is a tree-like [[cactus]], growing up to {{convert|5|m|ft}} tall.  The [[platyclade]]s have a thin fuzz of white hairs on their joints.

The plant is an [[invasive species]] in [[Florida]].

==Distribution==
The plant is [[endemism|endemic]] to [[Mexico]]. The cactus occurs in mountain [[habitat]]s, in the states of: [[San Luis Potosí]], [[Tamaulipas]], [[Zacatecas]], [[Guanajuato]], and [[Querétaro]].<ref name="grin" />
